name: Jacob Isaac Peterson
bio: Jacob Isaac Peterson is an American actor, singer, and voice actor based in San Diego, California. Born on July 17, 2014, in Poway, California, he has established a diverse early career spanning television, film, musical theater, voiceover, and commercial music. He is a SAG-Eligible performer represented by AEFH Youth & Young Adult.

credits.title: Cluck
credits.overview: A group of friends on a desert getaway are hunted by a feral killer in a chicken mask who butchers his victims using the same brutal methods used to slaughter animals.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
credits.overview: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family – to Greg's dismay – makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

credits.title: Coconut Girl
credits.overview: Shwetha, the 7-year-old child of Indian immigrants, struggles to reconcile her Asian heritage, specifically the custom of oiling her hair, with prevailing cultural norms around her, creating a rift between her and her beloved mother.

credits.title: Xanadu Hellfire
credits.overview: An eight-year-old girl finds a way to bring her warrior comic book heroine Xanadu Hellfire from the future to the present. Xanadu's evil sister follows, and stuff gets crazy. Inspired by everything from Conan to Thor, Mad Max, and Clerks.
